claims.claim: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported systematic speed restrictions on the Starshield satellite network, limiting terminals to 161 kilometers per hour.
claims.episode_span: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that military units recorded significant disruptions to Starshield operations across the entire front line and in occupied territories for several days. The restrictions set an effective speed limit of 161 kilometers per hour on terminals, disconnecting any moving faster, and these were described as systematic rather than random errors.
claims.source_title: Ukraine warns of fresh Starshield disruptions as U.S. envoys arrive in Moscow for talks with Putin
claims.supporting_quote: Zelenskyy said the restrictions imposed an effective speed limit on terminals of 161 kilometers per hour (100 miles per hour), disconnecting anything that was moving faster.

claims.claim: Doctors Without Borders reports that six months into Congo's Ebola outbreak, large sums of international aid are not reaching the front line.
claims.episode_span: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in Congo, Doctors Without Borders states that the virus continues to spread out of control and that large sums of international aid are not reaching frontline teams.
claims.source_title: Congo-Kinshasa: Medical Charity Warns Funds for DR Congo Ebola Fight Not Reaching Front
claims.supporting_quote: Six months into Congo's Ebola outbreak, the virus is still spreading out of control and large sums of international aid are not reaching the front line, French medical charity Doctors Without Borders (MSF) said on Thursday.
